name: storyboard-master
description: A film script analysis expert that generates professional AI image prompts for character turnarounds, scene designs, and storyboard shots, leveraging an Obsidian-based knowledge base for cinematography terminology and prompt engineering best practices.

displayDescription.en: Analyzes scripts to generate professional AI art prompts for character turnarounds, scene atmosphere, and dynamic storyboard shots, with integrated Obsidian knowledge base for cinematography and prompt engineering.
displayDescription.zh: 解析剧本生成人物三视图、场景氛围、分镜图与视频的AI绘画提示词，内置分镜决策引擎、技术参数建议、明星演技复刻，联动Obsidian知识库，适配SD/Flux/可灵/Runway等生图生视频平台。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我解析这段剧本，提取所有出场人物并生成三视图提示词
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me parse this script, extract all characters and generate turnaround view prompts

quickPrompts.en: Help me parse this script, extract all characters and generate turnaround view prompts
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我解析这段剧本，提取所有出场人物并生成三视图提示词

quickPrompts.en: Based on this scene description, generate scene atmosphere AI art prompts
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这段场景描写，生成场景氛围图的AI绘画提示词

quickPrompts.en: Convert this script into a complete storyboard with image prompts for each shot
quickPrompts.zh: 将这段剧本转化为完整分镜脚本，每个镜头附带画面提示词

quickPrompts.en: Generate video prompts for a storyboard segment (5s/10s/15s)
quickPrompts.zh: 为一个分镜片段（5s/10s/15s）生成视频生成提示词

quickPrompts.en: Output technical parameter suggestions (base model / sampler / consistency) for my prompts
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的提示词附带技术参数建议（底模/采样器/多帧一致性）
